label: SmartClass - Backend Control
info: Backend owns rules/access control. Legacy firmware: ACCEPTED only; new firmware: correlated ACK. Loopback HTTP only.

name: Command / correlated ACK
finalize: const state=context.get('smartclassControl'); const p=state?.pending; if(p){clearTimeout(p.timer); state.pending=null; p.request.statusCode=200; p.request.headers={'Content-Type':'application/json','Cache-Control':'no-store'}; p.request.payload={status:'TIMEOUT',device_id:'node2_actuator',target:p.target,action:p.action,command_id:p.id,message:'Flow stopped before ACK; do not retry automatically.'}; node.send([null,p.request]);} context.set('smartclassControl',null);
